commits.message:
feat(docs): many-file cards get a foldable file list (rich-demos-k78j.gjt) (#375)

* feat(docs): tabs that would wrap become a foldable list of files by folder (rich-demos-k78j.gjt)

An unseen one-row copy of the tabs, at the card's width, says when they no
longer fit; then they are a vertical tablist beside the editor, grouped by
folder, folded by a toggle, and folded from the start on a card narrower
than 720px. Tabs follow the grouped order in both layouts and the arrow
keys of both orientations move along it.

* fix(docs): one keyed shape for both tab layouts, measured from the real tab elements (rich-demos-k78j.gjt review)

A layout change no longer remounts the editor; each tab in the unseen row
is observed so a late font re-measures; the width picks the list's
opening state once; going back to a row wants 32px spare; the list is
at most 35% of the card; folded, the toggle's arrows switch files.

* fix(docs): the measuring row observes itself, for as long as it is in the page (rich-demos-k78j.gjt review)
